units.source_text: 我来到病室，见医生不知什么时候也来了。

en.t: When I came to the sickroom, I saw that the doctor had somehow arrived too.

units.source_text: 为了尽可能让病人舒服一些，他正试着给父亲灌肠。

en.t: To make the patient as comfortable as possible, he was trying to give my father an enema.

units.source_text: 由于劳累了一夜，护士正在别的房间睡觉，不懂护理常识的哥哥，正手忙脚乱地给医生打下手。

en.t: Worn out from working all night, the nurse was sleeping in another room, and my brother, who knew nothing about nursing, was flusteredly assisting the doctor.

units.source_text: 一见我进来，就说了句“快来帮个忙”，说完便坐了下来。

en.t: As soon as he saw me come in, he said, "Come help for a moment," and then sat down.

units.source_text: 我把哥哥替下来，把油纸垫在父亲屁股底下。

en.t: I took over from my brother and placed the oil paper under my father's hips.

units.source_text: 父亲的样子显得舒服些了。

en.t: My father seemed somewhat more comfortable.

units.source_text: 医生在枕边坐了大约半个小时，看了灌肠的结果后，说了声“我回头再来”，便回去了。

en.t: The doctor sat by the pillow for about half an hour, checked the result of the enema, said, "I will come back later," and went home.

units.source_text: 临走时又特意叮嘱说：“如果有事，可随时叫我。”

en.t: As he was leaving, he made a point of saying, "If anything happens, call me at any time."

units.source_text: 我也想退出随时可能有事的病房，接着去看先生的信。

en.t: I too wanted to leave the sickroom, where something might happen at any moment, and go on reading Sensei's letter.

units.source_text: 但是，我的心情丝毫没有得到一点放松。

en.t: But my feelings did not relax in the slightest.

units.source_text: 刚在桌前坐下来，便觉得哥哥又会大声喊我似的。

en.t: No sooner had I sat down at the desk than I felt as if my brother would call out loudly for me again.

units.source_text: 如果再喊我的话，那便是父亲最后的时刻了，恐惧使我的手颤抖起来。

en.t: If he called me again, that would mean my father's final moment had come, and fear made my hands tremble.

units.source_text: 我茫然地一页一页翻着先生的信，看见的只是规规矩矩嵌在方格中的字。

en.t: I blankly turned the pages of Sensei's letter one by one, seeing only the neat characters set inside the ruled squares.

units.source_text: 可是我没有心情仔细去看，连一目十行的心情也没有。

en.t: But I was in no state of mind to read it carefully, not even to skim through it.

units.source_text: 我一直翻到最后一页，正准备按照原来的样子叠起来放在桌上时，快到结尾的一句话，突然进入了我的眼睛：

en.t: I kept turning pages until the last one, and just as I was about to fold the letter back as it had been and place it on the desk, a sentence near the end suddenly caught my eye:

units.source_text: “当你接到这封信的时候，恐怕我已经离开这个世界，早已死了吧。”

en.t: "By the time you receive this letter, I will probably have left this world and already be dead."
